facts.fact: 风暴预计在一两个小时内北移离开。
facts.anchor: While the storm is expected to move north in the next hour or two

facts.fact: 坏消息：岛上又出了另一个紧急事件（another emergency）——具体是什么没有说。
facts.anchor: unfortunately, another emergency has arisen on the island

facts.fact: 一旦天气系统完全过去，将从 Welcome Center 疏散到游轮上。
facts.anchor: We will have to evacuate from the Welcome Center to the cruise ship once this weather system fully clears.

facts.fact: 承诺随时更新疏散的流程、时间与时长（as we have it）。
facts.anchor: We will keep you updated on the procedure, timing, and duration of the evacuation as we have it.

facts.fact: 感谢客人保持冷静，在"意外的局势转折"中保持耐心。
facts.anchor: Thank you for remaining calm, and your continued patience during this unexpected turn of events.
